content: Is the CslibTests.lean change in the last mathlib bump (commit id: 1f601a245d0b16c68c36c86ea2f7f133dc75ea0b) necessary? I ask this because running lake exe mk_all --module reverts that change.

Yes, this is required. Two parts here:

First is that the meaning of --module changed in #38395. You no longer need to pass this, and doing so now only has the meaning of explicitly changing imports from non-module to module.

The state of things before was odd: CslibTests was not using the module system, but CslibTests.lean was. I guess this worked because of the globs, which weren't what was wanted build-wise. This is how these imports should have been written to begin with.

(I also could have changed CslibTests to use the module system, but I try to make the least semantically different change on the Mathlib bump PRs. It felt more correct to fix the imports for what was currently there.)
The globs were fine for CslibTests, just not for Cslib
This would be fine too, I'd merge a PR doing so.
So the upshot is that I should drop --module from lake exe mk_all?
